title: gentiana eonae
intro: Gentiana eonae, commonly known as the High Himalayan gentian, is a plant species in the Gentianaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, helping to reduce oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Gentiana eonae include its use in traditional medicine to treat digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include gentiopicrin, gentianine, and amarogentin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
